
Plots of the gamma PDF for various values of the parameters are given in Fig.\ \@ref(fig:GammaDistribution).



```{r GammaDistribution, echo=FALSE, fig.align="center", fig.cap="The PDF of a gamma distribution for various values of $\\alpha$ and $\\beta$.", fig.width=7, fig.height=7, out.width='80%'}

par( mfrow = c(2, 2))

alpha <- c(0.7, 2,
           3, 6)
beta <- c(0.5, 1, 2)


for (i in (1:length(alpha))){
  alphai <- alpha[i]
  
  if ( (i == 1) | ( i == 2 ) ) xmax <- 8
  if (i == 3) xmax <- 10
  if (i == 4) xmax <- 12
  
  x <- seq(0, xmax,
           length = 100)

  plot(x = x,
       y = dgamma(x,
                  shape = alphai,
                  scale = beta[1]),
       xlab = expression(italic(x)),
       ylab = "Prob. density",
       las = 1,
       lwd = 2,
       col = plotColour1,
       type = "l",
       main = bquote("Gamma distributions:" ~ alpha == .(alphai) ) ) 

  lines( x = x,
         y = dgamma(x,
                  shape = alphai,
                  scale = beta[2]),
         col = plotColour1,
         lty = 2,
         lwd = 2)
  lines( x = x,
         y = dgamma(x,
                  shape = alphai,
                  scale = beta[3]),
         col = plotColour1,
         lty = 3,
         lwd = 2)
  legend("topright",
         lwd = 2,
         lty = 1:3,
         bty = "n",
         col = plotColour1,
         legend = c(bquote( beta == .(beta[1])),
                    bquote( beta == .(beta[2])),
                    bquote( beta == .(beta[3]))))

}
```
